services.name: Tuna Fishing
services.desc: Helen H Offshore runs groundfish fishing trips out of Hyannis Harbor and Plymouth Harbor on Cape Cod, targeting cod, haddock, pollock, and redfish on some of New England’s most productive fishing grounds including Georges Bank, Jeffery’s Ledge, Stellwagen Bank, and Nantucket Shoals. Cape Cod groundfish trips run from spring through late fall, with options ranging from single day trips to 2-day combo adventures aboard the F/V Helen H and F/V Angler. blurb: Helen H Offshore offers fishing trips and sunset cruises from Hyannis Harbor, Cape Cod. They have over 50 years of experience catching local fish species including tuna, fluke, porgies, black sea bass, and striped bass. Guests can book private fishing charters, ferry service, and various fishing trips including half day and inshore options.
